'''melek.salon''' is the principal social front end of the [[MELEK Blockchain|MELEK]] chain — the interface where posts are written, read, voted and rewarded. It is a condenser-family front end, the same software lineage used by the other Graphene social chains.

== Related surfaces ==
* wallet.melek.salon — account signup and wallet. Keys are generated in the browser and are not transmitted to the operator.
* [[Witness School|witness.melek.salon]] — documentation and courses.
